description: This file implements a set of reasoners for evaluating the relevance of responses to questions using a multi-jury consensus pattern. It includes functions for question analysis, individual juror evaluations (literal, intent, scope), a jury foreman for synthesizing votes, and orchestrator functions for full and quick evaluations.

methods.name: register_relevance_reasoners
methods.description: Registers all relevance-related reasoners with the provided router object.
